consumer: The frontend/engine site asking the boolean 'does the avatar currently have line of sight to this tile?', consuming an engine-computed visibility predicate.
scope: The avatar's true line-of-sight reach (its actual sight range), not an arbitrary export window.
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles emits seen=map::pl_sees(p, ctx.radius), which computes player visibility but gates it on the export radius ctx.radius rather than the avatar's real sight range.
divergence: A tile with clear, lit line of sight to the avatar but sitting just beyond ctx.radius: the avatar truly has LOS, yet pl_sees(p, ctx.radius) returns false, so the surface reports no-LOS for a tile the avatar actually sees.
